metadata.title: Join a queue - LineME
metadata.description: Find a LineME queue by code, shared link, or QR code and join from your phone.

joinLine.title: Find and join your line
joinLine.description: Enter the 10-character line code, open a shared LineME link, or scan the QR code provided by the team.

search.title: Enter a line code
search.description: Use the code displayed by the business or sent to you.
search.label: Line code

sharedLink.title: Open a shared link
sharedLink.description: Shared links open the correct line automatically. No code entry is needed.

qr.title: Scan a QR code
qr.description: Use your phone camera to scan the LineME QR code at the location.

scanner.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR code
scanner.unsupportedTitle: QR scanning is not supported here
scanner.unsupportedDescription: Open the shared link or enter the line code above.
scanner.errorDescription: Allow camera access and try again, or enter the line code.

empty.title: Your line will appear here
empty.description: Search with a code or scan a QR code to review the line before joining.

saved.title: Lines you already joined
saved.description: These private tickets are saved in this browser.

leave.title: Leave this line?
leave.confirm: Leave {name}? Your ticket will be cancelled and removed from this browser.

form.title: A few details before you join
form.description: These questions were added by the team managing this line.
form.readyDescription: This line does not require any information from you.

success.title: Joined {name}
success.saved: Your private ticket has been saved on this device. Keep this browser available for queue updates.
success.servedInfo: This ticket has already been served. No further queue updates are needed.
success.cancelledInfo: This ticket was cancelled and is no longer active.

errors.notFound: We could not find a line with that code. Check the code and try again.
errors.lookup: The line could not be loaded right now. Please try again.
errors.line_not_active: This line is not accepting new visitors right now.
errors.line_at_capacity: This line has reached its capacity for today.
errors.required_answer_missing: Complete all required questions before joining.
errors.join_failed: You could not be added to the line. Please try again.
errors.leave_failed: You could not leave the line right now. Please try again.
errors.already_completed: This ticket has already been completed and cannot be cancelled.
errors.response_failed: Your response could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.ticket_lookup: Your saved ticket could not be refreshed right now.
